text:
Use with caution / monitor.

Rifampin functions as an inducer of several cytochrome P450 enzymes, including CYP2C9, 1A2, and 3A4 [rifampin:drug_interactions:1]. Because warfarin is metabolized by these exact isozymes, coadministration with rifampin increases warfarin metabolism and decreases its systemic exposure [warfarin:drug_interactions:2]. Consequently, this lowered exposure can decrease the anticoagulant effect of warfarin [warfarin:drug_interactions:2].
